description: Marvell Technology, Inc., together with its consolidated subsidiaries, is a leading supplier of data infrastructure semiconductor solutions, spanning the data center core to network edge, and is a fabless supplier of high-performance semiconductor products with core strengths in developing and scaling complex System-on-a-Chip architectures, integrating analog, mixed-signal and digital signal processing functionality, leveraging leading intellectual property and deep system-level expertise, as well as highly innovative security firmware, to empower the data economy and enable the data center and communications and other end markets. It is incorporated in Delaware with corporate headquarters at 1000 N. West Street, Suite 1200, Wilmington, Delaware, and has operations in many countries, including Argentina, China, India, Israel, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam, serving end markets including cloud and on-premise ethernet switching, network-attached storage, AI servers, general-purpose servers, storage systems, data center interconnect, enterprise networking, campus and small medium enterprise routers, switches and wireless access points, and network appliances such as firewalls and load balancers.
